theorems.name: Submission.cbr_rlim_smooth_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t ε : ℝ), Continuous f → 0 < ε → ∃ (χ : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ t - ε → χ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, t ≤ f x → χ x = 0)
